title: 騎車去還人的錢
genre: Taigi narrative rap over live band
subject: riding over with five thousand in a red envelope to repay a friend who never once asked
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien narrative rap backed by a live band, in the recent chill-Taigi street-feel idiom. Real drum kit played loose with a fat kick, electric bass sitting slightly behind, muted electric guitar scratching on the offbeats, electric piano holding sustained chords, one trumpet line at the end. Live and unpolished with the room audible, no sample replacement. Male voice rapping in a plain everyday street register, unhurried and conversational, no doubling and no autotune. 94 BPM, C minor. Embarrassed gratitude. No 808, no trap hi-hats, no sung pop chorus, no synth lead, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
五千箍 借了十一個月 伊無催過一次
無催比催較歹 催的話阮有藉口受氣
今仔日領薪水 阮第一件代誌就是騎車去
三十分鐘的路 阮騎了四十五分 阮無想欲遐緊到

[Chorus]
五千箍 阮用紅包袋裝
伊看著彼個紅包袋 伊笑 伊講「你是咧做啥」
阮講「無代誌」 阮實在是感覺歹勢
歹勢無法度用錢還 所以阮用紅包袋

[Verse]
伊叫阮入去坐 阮講阮欲轉
伊講「你一定愛入來喝一杯茶」 阮入去
阮兩個講三十分鐘 攏無講錢
好朋友就是 錢的代誌講一句就好

[Chorus]
五千箍 阮用紅包袋裝
伊看著彼個紅包袋 伊笑 伊講「你是咧做啥」
阮講「無代誌」 阮實在是感覺歹勢
歹勢無法度用錢還 所以阮下次換阮請

[Bridge]
回去的路 阮騎較緊
身軀較輕 車嘛較輕

[Outro]
紅包袋 伊無還阮
伊收起來 阮看著
